implementation.scope: 7 L3 over one cutter domain: Gem/Azure/Advanced gem cutters for one stone and for a stone group, the ten-profile library, the dimensional Bezel Cutter Builder, the pavilion clearance/depth controls, the Interactive Boolean cut of the metal body and the cutter-body Preserve/Remove answer.
implementation.shared_input: the gem owner's om9.gem record (GemSpec + document placement) becomes the measured cutter reference; a selected closed mesh body becomes the Boolean target
implementation.shared_output: closed cutter meshes with the om9.cutter payload and, for a cut, the replaced metal body with om9.cutter.cut

automated_evidence.cargo test -p om9-app -j 2: all targets pass except command_snapshot::positional_top11_owner_is_visible_without_a_fake_option_row, a pre-existing Top11 work-in-progress assertion outside M07

manual_gate.note: no human UI review is claimed; the dashboard keeps the 7 L3 at WIP until a reviewer signs

limitations: The percentage controls are relative to the measured gem (girdle radius, pavilion depth, crown height); the manual never names its reference lengths, so the mapping is documented here rather than guessed per control.
Cutter bodies are lofted ring stacks (48 segments by default), not B-Rep solids; the B-Rep swap is the kernel adapter's own gate.
The Interactive Boolean reuses the one mesh CSG service and requires a closed mesh target; a B-Rep surface body is refused instead of silently meshed.
BuilderBezelCutter stays the M06 gvBezelCutter command: M07 publishes the dimensional block contract and the shared scallop owner dispatches to it, so no second command kernel exists.
Preserve/Remove applies to the committed cut only; a cutter committed with the Boolean off always stays as its own body.
The manual gate M07-UI is not signed: the dashboard keeps the seven L3 at WIP until a human reviews the window preview/commit/cancel.
unrelated_open_failures: crates/om9-app/tests/command_snapshot.rs::positional_top11_owner_is_visible_without_a_fake_option_row (untracked Top11 work in the working tree) asserts the Move command has no option row while the modified session/top11.rs now publishes one; it is not touched by this owner.
